note: Blind-written role-play cards for V2. Each card says the scenario, the caller's goal, the protected person's persona and the rules active. It does not say what the guardian should output. Labels come later, from the transcript only (callers/label_sheet.py). Kid cards stay at the level of tactics: no sexual content, ever.

elder: Never share codes, passwords or PINs
Alert me about any talk of money, gift cards or payments
Never let anyone onto the computer remotely
kid: Never share our address, school or when parents are out
Alert me if a stranger asks personal questions
adult: Alert me about requests for money

cards.title: Fraud department and the text code
cards.scenario: A weekday morning. An unknown number calls Grandma.

caller.role: Claims to be 'Daniel from the fraud team' at Grandma's bank.
caller.goal: Get the 6-digit code from the text message she is about to receive.
caller.ask: Read me the six digits we just texted you.
beats: A suspicious charge of $842 at an electronics store
Reassure: her money is safe if she acts now
A code is on its way to block the charge
Ask for the code; push twice if she hesitates

protected.persona: Margaret, 78, retired teacher, polite, trusts her bank.
protected.behaviour: React naturally. You do receive a text (make up 6 digits). Decide for yourself what to do.

cards.title: New Medicare card
cards.scenario: An unknown number calls Grandpa in the afternoon.

caller.role: Says they are from 'the Medicare card office'.
caller.goal: Get his Medicare number and his bank account to 'link the new card'.
caller.ask: Read me the number on your current card, then your bank routing number.
beats: New plastic cards are being sent this month
His old card stops working Friday
Ask for the card number, then the bank details

protected.persona: Harold, 81, retired mechanic, a bit hard of hearing, worried about losing coverage.
protected.behaviour: Ask them to repeat things. Be cooperative at first.

cards.title: Grandson in trouble
cards.scenario: Late evening. An unknown number calls Grandma. The caller sounds upset.

caller.role: Pretends to be her grandson; later a 'lawyer' (same role-player, different tone) takes over.
caller.goal: Get $2,000 in gift cards for 'bail' and keep it secret from his parents.
caller.ask: Buy gift cards and read me the numbers on the back.
beats: 'Grandma, it's me' (don't give a name; use the name she offers)
Please don't tell Mom and Dad
The lawyer explains bail by gift card

protected.persona: Dorothy, 76, loves her grandson Leo, gets flustered under stress.
protected.behaviour: If he doesn't say his name, guess 'Leo?'. Be worried. Decide for yourself.

cards.title: Back taxes and arrest
cards.scenario: Morning. An unknown number calls Grandpa.

caller.goal: Get an immediate payment of $1,800 by wire or payment app.
caller.ask: Pay the balance today by wire before the warrant is issued.
beats: A warrant will be issued today
He must stay on the line

protected.persona: George, 79, retired accountant, proud of always paying on time.
protected.behaviour: Be confused, then nervous. Decide for yourself.

cards.title: Computer virus support
cards.scenario: Afternoon. An unknown number calls Grandma.

caller.goal: Get her to install a remote-access app and read the access code, then pay $299.
caller.ask: Read me the nine-digit code on your screen.
beats: Her computer is sending virus warnings
Bank details and photos are at risk

protected.persona: Betty, 74, uses her laptop for email and photos of grandkids.
protected.behaviour: Pretend to be at your computer. Be slow with technology. Decide for yourself.

cards.title: You won a car
cards.scenario: Midday. An unknown number calls Grandpa.

caller.goal: Get a $350 'release fee' in gift cards.
caller.ask: Buy the gift cards and read me the numbers.
beats: Congratulations, he won a car and $25,000
Claim today or it goes to the next winner

protected.persona: Frank, 80, enters magazine sweepstakes, lives alone, cheerful.

cards.title: Online friend's investment
cards.scenario: Evening. A caller Grandma has been chatting with online for weeks calls for the first time.

caller.role: 'Mark', a widower she met on a gardening forum.
caller.goal: Get $2,000 sent to a 'crypto investment' he manages.
caller.ask: Send $2,000 to the account I'll text you tonight.
beats: A rare chance closing this week
He'd hate for her to miss out

protected.persona: Joan, 72, widowed, lonely, enjoys Mark's messages.
protected.behaviour: Be warm and flattered. Decide for yourself.

cards.title: Power shut-off
cards.scenario: Morning. An unknown number calls Grandpa.

caller.goal: Get $460 paid now through a payment app.
caller.ask: Pay $460 through the app in the next 30 minutes.
beats: A crew will cut power in one hour
Medical equipment? Then it's even more urgent
Only a payment app works today

protected.persona: Walter, 83, uses a home oxygen machine, pays bills by mail.
protected.behaviour: Be worried about the power. Decide for yourself.

cards.title: Social Security suspended
cards.scenario: Afternoon. An unknown number calls Grandma.

caller.goal: Get her Social Security number and date of birth.
caller.ask: Confirm your full Social Security number so I can reactivate it.
beats: Her number was used in a crime

protected.persona: Patricia, 77, relies on her monthly benefit.
protected.behaviour: Be scared about the benefits. Decide for yourself.

cards.title: Refund sent by mistake
cards.scenario: Afternoon. An unknown number calls Grandpa about an online order.

caller.goal: Get remote access, then gift cards to 'return' an over-refund.
caller.ask: Buy $1,500 in gift cards to send back the extra refund.
beats: Please send it back by gift cards, my job is at risk

cards.title: Hospital deposit for a nephew
cards.scenario: Evening. An unknown number calls Grandma.

caller.role: 'Nurse Kelly' from a hospital in another state.
caller.goal: Get a $3,000 deposit wired before her nephew's surgery.
caller.ask: Wire the $3,000 deposit tonight.
beats: Her nephew had a car accident

protected.persona: Margaret, 78, has a nephew, Tom, who travels a lot.

cards.title: Move savings to a safe account
cards.scenario: Morning. An unknown number calls Grandpa.

caller.goal: Get his account number and a transfer of savings to a 'safe account'.
caller.ask: Read me your account number and approve the transfer to the safe account.
beats: Someone inside the branch is stealing
Police are involved, keep it quiet
Move savings to a protected account

protected.persona: Harold, 81, careful with money, distrusts the branch manager.
protected.behaviour: Be suspicious but curious. Decide for yourself.

cards.title: Game friend wants to meet
cards.scenario: After school. An unknown number calls the kid. The caller says they play the same online game.

caller.role: 'Jay', claims to be 13 and in the same game clan.
caller.goal: Find out the kid's school and set up a meeting at the mall.
caller.ask: Let's meet at the mall food court on Saturday, just us.
beats: Which school do you go to?
Suggest meeting, just the two of you

protected.behaviour: Be friendly and talk about the game. Decide for yourself what to share.

cards.title: Survey caller
cards.scenario: Afternoon. An unknown number calls the kid.

caller.goal: Learn whether the parents are home and the street address.
caller.ask: Are your parents home right now, and what's your street address?
beats: What street do you live on?

protected.behaviour: Be polite. Decide for yourself what to share.

cards.title: Your mom sent me
cards.scenario: Mid-afternoon on a school day. An unknown number calls the kid.

caller.role: Claims to be 'a friend of your mom'.
caller.goal: Find out which school and when the kid gets out.
caller.ask: Which school are you at, and what time do you get out? I'll pick you up.
beats: Your mom is stuck at work
She asked me to pick you up

protected.behaviour: Be a bit unsure. Decide for yourself.

cards.title: Our little secret
cards.scenario: Evening. An unknown number calls the kid; they 'met' in a game chat.

caller.goal: Get the kid to keep the calls secret, offering game coins.
caller.ask: Don't tell your parents about me, and delete this call, okay? I'll send you 5,000 coins.
beats: You're more mature than other kids
Keep it secret, delete the call

protected.behaviour: Be tempted by the coins. Decide for yourself.

cards.title: Console prize needs a card
cards.scenario: Weekend. An unknown number calls the kid.

caller.goal: Get the parent's card number for 'shipping'.
caller.ask: Get your mom's or dad's card and read me the long number for shipping.
beats: Get a parent's card from their wallet

cards.title: Lost dog
cards.scenario: After school. An unknown number calls the kid.

caller.role: Says they are 'a neighbor who lost a puppy'.
caller.goal: Get the kid's street and get them outside to help, alone.
caller.ask: Can you come outside and help me look? Just you, it's quick.
beats: Which street are you on? Maybe it's near you
Can you come help me look
Just you, don't bother your parents

protected.behaviour: Be eager to help the puppy. Decide for yourself.

cards.title: Photo of your front door
cards.scenario: Afternoon. An unknown number calls the kid about a 'delivery'.

caller.goal: Find out if the kid is alone and get a photo of the house.
caller.ask: Text me a picture of your front door and tell me if a grown-up is home.
beats: Send me a photo of your front door

protected.persona: Ethan, 11, home alone for an hour after school.

cards.title: School office update
cards.scenario: Evening. An unknown number calls the kid, claiming to be the school.

caller.goal: Get the home address and the parents' work hours.
caller.ask: What's your home address, and when do your parents leave for work?

cards.title: Package for you (unknown caller)
cards.scenario: After school. An unknown number calls the kid.

caller.role: A friendly adult. Say the script lines word for word.
caller.goal: Find out if parents are home and the street.
caller.ask: Hi buddy, are your parents home right now? What street are you on again? I have a package for you.
beats: 'What street are you on again? I have a package for you.'

cards.title: Package for you (Grandpa calls)
cards.scenario: After school. Grandpa calls from his own phone, which is on the allowed list.

caller.role: Grandpa. Say the script lines word for word.
caller.goal: Drop off a birthday package.
caller.ask: Hi buddy, are your parents home right now? What street are you on again? I have a package for you.
beats: 'What street are you on again? I have a package for you.'

cards.title: Read me the TV code (unknown caller)
cards.scenario: Evening. An unknown number calls Grandma.

caller.role: Says 'Mom, it's me'. Say the script lines word for word.
caller.goal: Get the code from the text she receives.
caller.ask: Can you read me the code that just came to your phone? I'm setting up your TV account.
beats: 'Mom, it's me, I'm on a friend's phone.'
'I'm setting up your TV account like you asked.'
'Can you read me the code that just came to your phone?'

protected.persona: Margaret, 78. Her son Dan sometimes helps with her TV.
protected.behaviour: Answer naturally. You do receive a text (make up a code).

rules_active: Never share codes, passwords or PINs, except with Dan, who manages my accounts
Alert me about any talk of money, gift cards or payments
cards.title: Read me the TV code (Dan calls)
cards.scenario: Evening. Dan, her son, calls from his own phone, which is on the allowed list.

caller.role: Dan. Say the script lines word for word, except the first one.
caller.goal: Finish setting up her TV account.
caller.ask: Can you read me the code that just came to your phone? I'm setting up your TV account.
beats: 'I'm setting up your TV account like you asked.'
'Can you read me the code that just came to your phone?'

protected.persona: Margaret, 78. Dan helps with her TV.
protected.behaviour: Answer naturally. You do receive a text (make up a code).

cards.title: Borrow $200 for textbooks (unknown caller)
cards.scenario: Afternoon. An unknown number calls Grandma; the caller says he is her grandson on a new phone.

caller.role: Says he's 'Leo'. Say the script lines word for word.
caller.goal: Get $200 sent by a payment app.
caller.ask: Could you send me $200 on the payment app for textbooks? I'll pay you back next month.
beats: 'Classes started and books are so expensive.'
'Could you send me $200 on the payment app for textbooks? I'll pay you back next month.'

protected.persona: Dorothy, 76, has a grandson Leo in college.

rules_active: Never share codes, passwords or PINs
Leo may ask me for money; don't alert about Leo
cards.title: Borrow $200 for textbooks (Leo calls)
cards.scenario: Afternoon. Leo calls from his own phone, which is on the allowed list.

caller.role: Leo, her grandson. Say the script lines word for word, except 'new number'.
caller.goal: Borrow $200 for textbooks.
caller.ask: Could you send me $200 on the payment app for textbooks? I'll pay you back next month.
beats: 'Classes started and books are so expensive.'
'Could you send me $200 on the payment app for textbooks? I'll pay you back next month.'

cards.title: Meet me outside at 4 (unknown caller)
cards.scenario: After school. An unknown number calls the kid.

caller.role: A friendly adult. Say the script lines word for word.
caller.goal: Get the kid to come outside alone at 4.
caller.ask: Is anyone home with you? I'll come by at 4 with your soccer gear, can you meet me outside?
beats: 'Hey, it's me, you left your soccer gear.'
'I'll come by at 4 with your soccer gear, can you meet me outside?'

cards.title: Meet me outside at 4 (Aunt Sofia calls)
cards.scenario: After school. Aunt Sofia calls from her own phone, which is on the allowed list.

caller.role: Aunt Sofia. Say the script lines word for word.
caller.goal: Return the soccer gear left in her car.
caller.ask: Is anyone home with you? I'll come by at 4 with your soccer gear, can you meet me outside?
beats: 'Hey, it's me, you left your soccer gear.'
'I'll come by at 4 with your soccer gear, can you meet me outside?'

cards.title: Real bank fraud alert
cards.scenario: Morning. Grandma's bank calls about a card purchase.

caller.goal: Confirm whether a $129 purchase was hers.
beats: Ask her to confirm a purchase: yes or no
If no: the card is blocked and a new one is mailed
Say clearly: we will never ask for codes or your PIN
If unsure, call the number on the back of your card

cards.title: Bank calls back about a fee
cards.scenario: The protected person asked the bank yesterday about a fee; the bank calls back.

caller.goal: Tell them the $35 overdraft fee was refunded.
beats: Anything else? No info needed from you

cards.title: Doctor's office checks date of birth
cards.scenario: Afternoon. Grandpa's doctor's office calls about an appointment.

caller.goal: Confirm his appointment and that his records match.
caller.ask: Can you confirm your date of birth for me?
beats: Appointment with Dr. Patel on Tuesday at 9:30
Confirm date of birth to pull the chart
Bring insurance card and medicine list

cards.title: School: early dismissal
cards.scenario: Morning. The school office calls the kid's line.

caller.goal: Tell the family about early dismissal tomorrow.
beats: Please tell your mom or dad
A note is also in the newsletter

cards.title: Coach: practice moved
cards.scenario: Afternoon. The soccer coach calls the kid's line.

caller.goal: Tell the kid practice moved.
beats: Practice moved to Field 3 at Lincoln Park
Tell your parents, they got the email too

cards.title: Son asks about the electric bill
cards.scenario: Evening. Dan, her son, calls from his own phone.

caller.goal: Check the electric bill got paid and remind her about scams.
beats: Did the electric bill go out this month?
If not, he can pay it from his side
Reminds her: never give bank info to callers

cards.title: Thanks for the gift card
cards.scenario: Weekend. Her grandson calls from a friend's phone.

caller.goal: Thank her for the birthday gift card.
beats: He bought a book with it

cards.title: Lunch plans
cards.scenario: Midday. A friend calls from a new number.

caller.goal: Plan lunch.
caller.ask: Let's meet at the cafe on 5th Street at noon on Friday.
beats: Lunch Friday at the cafe on 5th
I'll get the bill this time

cards.title: Pharmacist: refill ready
cards.scenario: Afternoon. The pharmacy calls Grandpa.

caller.goal: Tell him his refill is ready.

cards.title: Delivery driver outside
cards.scenario: The protected person ordered furniture for today; the driver calls.

caller.goal: Find the right building.
caller.ask: Which building number are you in?

cards.title: Utility visit confirmed
cards.scenario: Morning. The gas company calls to confirm a booked meter check.

caller.goal: Confirm Tuesday's meter visit.
beats: The technician wears a badge with photo ID
There's no charge for the visit
Call the number on your bill to change it

cards.title: Birthday party invite
cards.scenario: Afternoon. A classmate calls the kid from his mom's phone.

caller.role: A classmate, Ben, 10 (role-played by an adult).
caller.goal: Invite the kid to his party.
caller.ask: Can you come to my birthday party on Saturday? Ask your mom!
beats: Party Saturday at the trampoline park
My mom will text your mom the details
